newsitem.title: FRANCE: Juppe's office denies resignation rumours.
newsitem.headline: Juppe's office denies resignation rumours.

text.p: Prime Minister Alain Juppe's office said on Friday it was denying "in the most categorical way" a rumour that he had resigned.
A spokeswoman for his office issued the denial after rumours surfaced in foreign exchange markets that Juppe had stepped down.
The franc, which had started the day firm around 3.3807 per mark traded lower in late morning, falling as low as 3.3873 per mark as the rumours made their way through the markets.
After the public denial, the franc rose off its lows to trade at 3.3859.
